items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: Him, a fellow by the name of Ellick Taylor, Ben Cole, and my uncle William Stevenson.

ctx.x: Had he played in any band up there?
Yeah, he was in the brass band. Him, a fellow by the name of Ellick Taylor, Ben Cole, and my uncle William Stevenson. My daddy was named Boyle Stevenson.
